user.title: PoolManager
user.description: How should Home Assistant reach your PoolManager? Local is recommended: readings stay on your network.

cloud.title: Bayrol portal
cloud.description: Your bayrol-poolaccess.de credentials. The device id is detected automatically; it is the number after `c=` in the portal address when you open the device (…/device.php?c=12345).

local.title: Local network
local.description: IP address of the PoolManager on your network (check your router's client list, or the device menu Communication & Interfaces → Network (IP) Configuration). Readings work right away; for writes, see the integration options.

error.invalid_auth: The Bayrol portal rejected these credentials
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the PoolManager (see the Home Assistant log for details)
error.no_data: Connected, but no reading was received
error.remote_login_failed: The PoolManager refused the remote user login (check user name and password in the device menu User management)

init.title: Options
init.description: Local entries are read-only until writes are enabled. Either enter the device's remote user (local writes, recommended), or your Bayrol portal credentials (writes go through the cloud portal; readings stay local).

error.invalid_auth: The Bayrol portal rejected these credentials
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the PoolManager (see the Home Assistant log for details)
error.no_data: Connected, but no reading was received
error.remote_login_failed: The PoolManager refused the remote user login (check user name and password in the device menu User management)

set_timer_interval.name: Set a filtration interval
set_timer_interval.description: Changes one interval of the filter pump timer. Only the fields you provide are changed.

days.name: Days
days.description: Active days (empty list disables the interval)

entry_id.name: PoolManager
entry_id.description: Only needed if several PoolManagers are configured

write_refused_local.message: The PoolManager refused the change ({error}). Local writes need the device's remote user: set it in the integration options (or enter your Bayrol portal credentials there).

write_failed.message: Could not send the change to the PoolManager: {error}

nothing_to_change.message: Nothing to change: provide start, end, mode or days
